hooks.command: bash -c 'TOOL_INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))"); case "$FILE_PATH" in */frontend/src/*) ./frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$FILE_PATH" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac'
